tests: Choosing a storage class for millions of objects with unpredictable access and no manual tiering.
expected: S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects between tiers based on usage, with no retrieval fees or performance impact. Triggers: "unpredictable access patterns", "without manual tiering", "no performance impact".
why_not: Standard doesn't optimize cost; Deep Archive has slow retrieval; One Zone-IA reduces resilience.
